instruction: The faint sound of birds chirping outside adds a tranquil touch to the room. A fluffy cushion sits comfortably on the armchair, looking inviting. Could you navigate to the floorlamp and stay close to it? The warm glow of the sunlight enhances the wooden furniture's natural tones.
